With continuous advancement in technology, engineering insurance requirements are constantly evolving. Customer expectations regarding insurance are changing significantly. There is a need to modify the current products under the Engineering retail segment in line with the changing needs and demand. With this view, it has been decided to constitute a Working Group to revisit the Engineering products (which are as per the erstwhile tariffs) for the Retail segment of products. # 2.
